title: Affine descent of the supplied derived projection mate
statement: Use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], their canonical K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a morphism f, an adjunction p:Lf^*\dashv Rf_* with counit \epsilon and a natural isomorphism t:Lf^*(-\otimes^L-)\simeq Lf^*(-)\otimes^L Lf^*(-), write \pi_{p,t}(M,L) for the adjunction transpose of t_{M,Rf_*L} followed by 1_{Lf^*M}\otimes\epsilon_L. Fix scheme universe u. Assume that for every commutative ring A of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated Z of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec} A, every p,t as above and every N\in D_{QCoh}(\operatorname{Spec} A), E\in D_{QCoh}(Z), the mate \pi_{p,t}(N,E) is invertible in all choices of the two derived localizations with morphism universe u+1. Then for every quasi-compact quasi-separated X,Y of universe u, every quasi-compact quasi-separated f:X\to Y, all derived localizations in any common morphism universe w, every p,t and M\in D_{QCoh}(Y), L\in D_{QCoh}(X), the mate \pi_{p,t}(M,L) is invertible.

proof.text: Denote the original mate by alpha. By Mathlib DerivedCategory.isIso_iff it suffices to show that every homology map H^n(alpha) is invertible. The affine opens cover Y, by Mathlib iSup_affineOpens_eq_top.

For each affine open V obtain the affine chart certificate, including g,q,s,N,E and the implication from its affine mate to the restricted homology maps. Install its ring, compactness, quasi-separatedness and standard localization instances. Apply haffine to this specific g,q,s,N,E, then apply the certificate implication in degree n.

Apply sheaf_module_isIso_iff_isIso_over_open_cover to H^n(alpha) on the cover of all affine opens. This makes every homology map invertible; the derived-category criterion gives invertibility of alpha. The empty-target case is already included by the same cover theorem.

proof_origin.place: Affine-local reduction, implemented using the chart certificate, sheaf locality and Mathlib DerivedCategory.isIso_iff.
